visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with long dark hair sits on a bed covered with a white sheet. She wears a light purple long-sleeved shirt with a ruffled collar. She holds a gold-colored tablet and looks at the screen while speaking. Behind her is a light-colored wooden wardrobe. (2) A close-up shows the tablet screen displaying an image of the character Wednesday Addams with her signature braids and black attire. The girl's reflection is faintly visible on the tablet's glass surface as she points toward the image. (3) The girl looks off-camera towards the right and opens her mouth wide as if shouting. She then starts to crawl across the white bed towards the edge, moving out of the frame. The wooden wardrobe remains the static background. (4) An adult woman with short brown hair in a patterned grey shirt and an adult man with glasses in a tan shirt stand in front of a light-colored wooden door. They clasp their hands together and look towards the camera with wide smiles and excited expressions. (5) The young girl stands in front of a white door and wall. She is now wearing a black button-down shirt, a black pleated skirt, and black tights with loafers. She has several badges on her shirt and a red-and-white striped tie. She holds the tablet which displays the 'TGI FRIDAYS' logo. (6) The girl remains in the same position, looking solemnly at the camera to maintain her character. She reaches up with her right hand to adjust the striped tie around her neck while keeping her expression neutral and serious. (7) The woman and man from before stand in the same hallway. The woman has her hand on her forehead and eyes closed in a distressed expression. The man stands beside her, gesturing with his hands and looking towards her as if explaining or arguing about something.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A young female voice speaks in a casual, conversational tone with a light musical backing featuring simple percussion and synth pads. The vocal pitch is naturally high for a child with moderate speed. (2) The young female voice suddenly increases in volume and intensity, shouting 'Mama!' with high emotional arousal while the background music continues steadily. (3) A sharp record scratch sound effect occurs, signaling a narrative transition, followed by a brief moment of silence before the background music resumes its upbeat tempo. (4) Two adult voices, one female and one male, speak simultaneously with very high pitch and excited intonations, conveying excessive praise and amazement. (5) A comical 'boing' sound effect plays, marking another transition. The adult male voice then speaks with a lower pitch and a corrective tone, while the adult female voice responds sheepishly. (6) The background music continues as the vocal interaction becomes more tense; the male speaker uses an authoritative falling intonation while the female speaker's voice is higher-pitched and fragmented.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A humorous family skit illustrating a misunderstanding where a daughter wants to cosplay the character Wednesday Addams, but her parents mistakenly dress her as a TGI Fridays employee, playing on the word 'Wednesday' (the day) vs 'Friday' (the restaurant).
